Title: Superior Pressing Flesh on Shambling Hord

Messages.Author: Rémi
Messages.Body:
Dear all,

Can you confirm that superior Pressing Flesh gives only 3 life to a Shambling Horde since Shambling horde's text says "It cannot gain life", please ?

Card Texts:
Pressing Flesh:
+1 stealth action.
[basic] Move an ally in any ash heap who was burned from play to your ready region with this card and life equal to its starting life. This ally is a zombie instead of what it used to be, gets -1 bleed, cannot gain life, and can play cards requiring basic Fortitude as a vampire.
[superior] As above, but with 1 additional life.

Shambling Horde:
Ally: Zombie with 3 life. 0 strength, 0 bleed.
[basic] After this ally enters play, remove an ally or vampire in your ash heap from the game or burn this ally. This ally gets +1 strength for each life it has. This ally can enter combat with a minion as a Ⓓ action. It cannot gain life (instead, any life it would gain goes to the blood bank).
[superior] As above, but this ally has 4 life.

Thanks in advance,
Rémi.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Rémi wrote:
> Dear all,
>
> Can you confirm that superior Pressing Flesh gives only 3 life to a Shambling Horde since Shambling horde's text says "It cannot gain life", please ?
>
Pressing Flesh also states that the ally cannot gain life; this does not prevent however the ally from coming in play with life.
An ally that comes into play with life doesn't count as "gaining life". A SH put in play with Pressing Flesh would come in play with 3 life at [thn] and 4 life at [THN].
